cards.source: original; register per REF 8.2 rule 5 — the India deck's card NAMES use romanised Hindi/Urdu, chosen because the jargon is itself the joke. The effect is the A Grave Inheritance archetype (REF 4.2.1) with the unexpressible conditional removed.
cards.name: Jumlai Dafaar

cards.name: Gumasta Nahi, Salaam Nahi

cards.name: Khel Adhoora Chhodo
cards.text: Discard every face-up Voter Card and deal three fresh ones. Then gain 1 Media and 1 Trust.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.2 rule 5. The extra-voter branch of the recovered Singularity (REF 4.2.1).
cards.name: Baap Rekho
cards.text: Gain 2 voters, which you may place in different zones. Then gain 1 resource of your choice.
